title: Rollback receipt
description: Receipt for a rollback operation at accept/rollback-receipt.json. Proves the previous state was restored and verified.

generation_id.description: Generation that was rolled back (the failed install).

rolled_back_to.description: Generation ID of the state restored, or 'clean' if no prior generation.

hashes_match.description: Whether all restored file hashes match the backup.

files_removed.description: New files from the failed generation that were removed.

recovery_required.description: True if rollback could not be fully verified and manual recovery is needed.
